status_definitions.DONE_VERIFIED_FROM_TERMINAL: The user supplied terminal output that verifies the stated source or check status; no independent authenticated observation by this handoff is implied.
status_definitions.DONE_REPORTED: A prior completed result is reported in the supplied history; the present handoff has not rerun or independently verified its raw inputs.
status_definitions.PROPOSED: A specified next task that has not been executed or marked approved by this tracker.
status_definitions.BLOCKED: A task cannot yet execute because its listed prerequisites are unresolved.
status_definitions.DONE_LOCAL_SYNTHETIC_TESTED: Implementation passed actual invented-data software tests in this session; no real-image or biological validation is implied.
